snippet.title: 1000 Rogues // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290290/1000_Rogues/

You have played roguelikes before, but have you played 1000 at the same time? In 1000 Rogues, the retro RPG auto-battler you literally can! Step right in, plug in your vintage gaming systems and get ready to delve into the retro dungeon.

Developed by
Robert Kopania
